record.label: Generalized QSP in segments of 1 a.u.
record.statement: The circuit for $t=1,\ldots,10$ a.u. uses $t$ segments of 1 a.u. each. Each segment uses generalized quantum signal processing of degree $135{,}867$ with Hamiltonian normalization $\lambda\approx1.356\times10^5$ Ha.
record.boundary: Every segment is 1 a.u. Some of the certificate and block-encoding parameters depend on $t$. The bound counts segment approximation and block-encoding error for each segment, and error from preparing and uncomputing the phase-gradient state once per run.
